description: NASA HEASARC SAO catalog, 258,944 entries after HEASARC removes 53 catalog duplicates. This replaces the Silesia-derived representation. Coordinates and proper motions are copied from TAP, with units recorded in metadata.

rights.attribution: NASA HEASARC SAO catalog; SAO Staff (1966), ADC/CDS I/131A, HEASARC online representation (2001).

conversion.selection: All rows returned by the three recorded lexicographically name-ordered TAP queries; no final overflow. VOTable BINARY doubles are copied without numerical transformation; NaN sentinels become absent fields.
conversion.serialization: Protocol Buffers compiler 3.25.3 descriptors, Python protobuf 6.33.1; deterministic=True. Fields are assigned in schema order and batches contain consecutive source rows.
conversion.missing_values: Missing/blank numeric and string fields are absent; explicit nonblank zero values retain optional-field presence. No random or generated values are added.
